protocol: Every completed Race/Sprint session from the 2023–2026 catalog. At the earliest recorded lap completion for each lap number, freeze the full grid and test whether any two distinct drivers pass the existing recent-lap, stint-fit and actual-gap rules and support at least one default stop schedule (0:3,3:0,0:0), H=12, own current compound, recorded track condition. Check all pairs until a supported example is found. This is session/decision availability, not coverage of every driver pair or lap-time accuracy; an available scenario is not a validated strategy recommendation. No support gates are relaxed.
